name: Tiago Xavier Braga
bio: Unity & C# developer crafting immersive experiences across WebGL, mobile, and VR. From multiplayer systems to interactive simulations — building games that are technically solid and genuinely fun.

about.title: Who I Am
paragraphs: Unity and C# developer focused on building immersive experiences for WebGL, mobile, and virtual reality. I work on games, simulators, and interactive systems with an emphasis on clean architecture, performance, and scalability.
My background and interests sit at the intersection of software engineering and game design. I aim to build technically robust systems while maintaining clear, engaging player interactions.
Outside of work, I spend time prototyping new mechanics, studying procedural generation, and debugging physics and system edge cases—usually with a cup of coffee nearby.

itchio.label: Play My Games
itchio.description: Check out my published games and prototypes on itch.io

experience.description: Shaped the studio's market niche and aligned creative vision with technical feasibility. Contributed to game design and core mechanic ideation, then implemented and refined gameplay systems in Unity — focusing on player clarity and seamless integration across game systems.
Building high-fidelity simulators in Unity for professional training environments. Architecting physics systems, AI modules, and complex mechanics that demand precision and real-world accuracy.
Solo indie studio founded to publish and ship personal game projects — from concept to release, handling all aspects of development, design, and deployment independently.

projects.title: Dominoes Colors
projects.description: A relaxing puzzle game where you mix colors as you place each piece on the board. The result of each mix determines your next move — match the checkered flag piece to win.

projects.title: Police Chase: Drift
projects.description: Arcade racing game where the adrenaline never stops. Speed through an isolated parking lot while escaping relentless police cars — drift, dodge ramps, and stay ahead for as long as you can.

projects.title: Train Rush
projects.description: Rebuild a forgotten station into a thriving transport empire. Unlock trains, expand terminals, and keep the crowds moving before they walk out the door.

projects.title: Boompact!
projects.description: A fast-paced multiplayer mobile racing game built around chaotic, competitive gameplay loops.
